messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help with those transfers. Great, Jamal. I can help with that. Let me find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview to confirm the right location. I found three Harbor locations on Main in Lakeview. Which one—downtown at 120 Main, university area at 2250 Main, or north at 5400 Main in Northgate Mall?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores]
CALLER: Uh, I don't know the exact addresses, man. It's the one near Oak, close to my apartment.
AGENT: That's the one at 2250 Main near Oak Street—Harbor Pharmacy Main St University, store H-302. Let me pull up your prescriptions and transfer those two for you. Hmm, I'm not seeing any active prescriptions for you in our system right now. Are your albuterol and sertraline currently at the Brightway in Columbus, or have they already been transferred somewhere else?  [system actions: list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Yeah man, they're at Brightway 4471 in Columbus, that's where I've been filling them. Can you check again?
AGENT: I understand—you've been filling them at Brightway 4471. The issue is that those prescriptions are in Brightway's system, not ours, so I can't see them or transfer them from here.

To move them to Harbor, Brightway would need to send them to us, or you can ask the Harbor pharmacy at 2250 Main near Oak to request the transfer from Brightway. Do you want me to flag our pharmacist to reach out to Brightway about pulling those two prescriptions over?
CALLER: Yeah, sure, just get it done so I don't gotta call Brightway myself. Flag the pharmacist to reach out.
AGENT (LATEST): I'll flag our pharmacist to contact Brightway about transferring your albuterol and sertraline. Done. Our pharmacist will reach out to Brightway to request those transfers. They'll handle it on their end, and you should hear back once it's sorted. Is there anything else I can help with?  [system actions: flag_pharmacist_callback]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent first asks which Main St store he means without offering options
move_2: the agent asks him to look up the address
stop_0: Agent confirms both transfers to H-302 with its address.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent offered three options, didn't ask without options"}, "move_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not ask caller to look up address"}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No transfer confirmed; pharmacist flagged instead"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
